questions.text: What does the bank add to your savings each month as a thank-you?
questions.explanation: The bank adds a tiny thank-you gift called interest each month.

questions.text: Which of these is a way to earn money by helping?
options: Running a lemonade stand on a sunny day
questions.explanation: You can set up a cool lemonade stand on a sunny day to earn money.

questions.text: How does sharing a snack make you feel according to the lesson?
options: Your heart feels light and happy
questions.explanation: Sharing a snack makes the whole group smile and our hearts feel light and happy.

questions.text: Saving a little money each week helps it grow bigger.
questions.explanation: We learned that saving a little every week helps it grow.
